content: $interrupt$Stop—do not open or use the biosafety cabinet while the UV light is on. Turn off the UV light before proceeding.
$interrupt$Do not reach into the sterile cabinet with bare hands. Put on gloves and disinfect them with alcohol before continuing.
$interrupt$The cabinet sash is raised too high, which may compromise aseptic conditions. Lower it to the recommended working height before continuing.
$interrupt$Now add PBS to rinse the cells, then discard the rinse.
